Process facts that differ from the brief: a full dev08.py regress takes 46-73 s on this machine (not ~12 min); the harness-set key timing is: a key set anywhere in physics step T, or in the idle phase after T, is first just_pressed in step T+1, and a key pulsed in two CONSECUTIVE steps (up and down at one resume) loses the first edge (the second down event overwrites the stamp before step T+1 reads it). That is a harness/engine property (a person cannot press twice in 16 ms), but S3 scenarios must not call kit.press() twice back to back on the same key: press_settled() is safe. Recipes for S3: a press on the choice input's first choosing tick after a Self-destruct = set the destruct and the fire key at the same resume (all in one frame); after a Shot kill or a Fuel crash (destruction in step N, after the choice input's tick) set the fire key in the idle phase after N (await get_tree().process_frame, once per step in a fixed-fps run) or in a unit_destroyed handler: it is read in N+1; Shot kill recipe as S1b (Units.retype, victim apply_damage(hp-1), hold_fire(1,1), destruction about 7 steps after the fire step); Fuel crash = Gyrocopter chosen and throttle held 600 steps on the shipped data.
